description: Defines the GenericResourceOwner class implementing ResourceOwnerInterface, representing a generic OAuth2 resource owner with methods to retrieve ID and response data.

classes.name: GenericResourceOwner
classes.description: Represents a generic resource owner for use with the GenericProvider, encapsulating response data and providing access methods.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the resource owner with response data and resource owner ID.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the identifier of the resource owner.

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Returns the raw response array representing the resource owner.
